method: Static inspection of an official SDK package, including exact reported one-based stack columns. Downloaded SDK code was not executed or installed.

sdk.urlSource: Installed official WeChat DevTools WeappVendor/cfg.json libs.3.16.3

stackMapping.meaning: Promise API fail adapter constructs an Error after removing the API:fail prefix.
Shared function wrapper executes callback r.apply.
Shared wrapped callback delegates to p.
API failure dispatcher invokes the supplied fail callback.
Shared API result handler passes a failure through the dispatcher.
Generic API callback delegates to result handler H.
Generic native-invoke callback passes its result to d.
Shared bridge result callback forwards the result to r.
Shared bridge returns a synchronous interceptor result via s(u).
Generic native invoke calls u.invoke; the API name remains the dynamic argument e.

origin.condition: A non-whitelisted bridge API is invoked before library isStarted, outside the allowed agent or worker contexts.
origin.promiseTransformation: Remove the leading API name and :fail prefix, create Error('too early'), and preserve errno.

libraryLifecycle.isStartedDefinition: The internal start event is present in the completed lifecycle event registry.
libraryLifecycle.implication: Normal entry-file execution follows start. This stack alone cannot identify whether an internal preload task or another early execution path invoked the API.

limitations: No business frame or native API name is retained in the supplied stack.
Matching SDK code and stack establishes the failure mechanism, not the caller or an application-level root cause.
Downloaded SDK source was only parsed as text. An attempted isolated VM replay was rejected by automatic approval review with blocked by policy; it was not retried or counted as validation.
The independent navigation hardening cannot be claimed to eliminate this incident.
